meta.name: eol-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Run a go/no-go assessment for retiring a product or feature, then right-size the effort. Use when someone says "we should probably kill this" and nobody has made the call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估产品是否该退役,并规划后续投入
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队对是否下架某个产品或功能迟迟做不了决定。
copy.tagline_en: Decide whether to retire a product and right-size the wind-down effort.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team can't decide whether to kill a product or feature.

howto.what: 装上后,当你考虑停用某个产品或功能时,它会先问最多4个问题(客户量、收入、合同等),然后给出一份评估:该不该停、该投入多大力气做、有哪些义务要查清楚。
howto.when: 当你想评估是否停用某个产品或功能时触发,常见说法是“我们大概该砍掉这个”但没人拍板;直接说“评估一下XX该不该停”也会启动。

say.text: 我们该不该停掉老的报表模块?用量降了60%,支持成本在涨。
say.note: Claude会启动评估流程,给结论和强度建议。

say.text: 给 NFA-200 控制器产品线做个停用评估,120个装机,有渠道伙伴。
say.note: 它会评估影响范围,并推荐投入的强度等级。

say.text: 领导总提该砍掉这个模块但没人拍板,帮我完整评估一次。
say.note: 它会先确认退役是否已定,再逐步引导。

howto.what_en: When you consider retiring a product or feature, Claude asks up to 4 questions (customers, revenue, contracts), then gives a verdict: stop or not, how much effort, and obligations to check.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say something like 'we should probably kill this' without a decision made, or when you explicitly ask to assess retiring a product/feature.

say_en.text: Should we retire legacy reporting module? Usage down 60%, support costs rising.
say_en.note: Claude starts assessment, gives verdict and intensity.

say_en.text: EOL readiness check on NFA-200 line: 120 installs, channel partners.
say_en.note: It sizes the blast radius and recommends an intensity level.

say_en.text: Exec keeps saying kill this module; no one decides. Run a full assessment.
say_en.note: It confirms retiring is the play first, then guides.
